def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Separator lines are the rows and columns that differ from the uniform
    # tile interiors. Their regular spacing defines the output lattice.
    def get_lines(is_row):
        n = h if is_row else w
        m = w if is_row else h
        lines = []
        for i in range(n):
            vals = [grid[i][j] if is_row else grid[j][i] for j in range(m)]
            if len(set(vals)) > 1:
                lines.append(i)
        return lines

    def spacing(lines):
        ds = [b - a for a, b in zip(lines, lines[1:])]
        return max(set(ds), key=ds.count)

    rl = get_lines(True)
    cl = get_lines(False)
    rs, cs = spacing(rl), spacing(cl)

    # Choose the most frequent phase of the separator lines.
    rp = max(range(rs), key=lambda p: sum(x % rs == p for x in rl))
    cp = max(range(cs), key=lambda p: sum(x % cs == p for x in cl))
    rmarks = list(range(rp, h, rs))
    cmarks = list(range(cp, w, cs))

    nr = max(1, len(rmarks) - 1)
    nc = max(1, len(cmarks) - 1)

    # Interior fill color is the most common grid value.
    freq = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row:
            freq[v] = freq.get(v, 0) + 1
    fill = max(freq, key=freq.get)
    out = [[fill for _ in range(nc)] for _ in range(nr)]

    # The separator background is the most common value along the lattice.
    lattice = [grid[r][c] for r in rmarks for c in cmarks]
    sepbg = max(set(lattice), key=lattice.count)

    for i, r in enumerate(rmarks[:nr]):
        for j, c in enumerate(cmarks[:nc]):
            v = grid[r][c]
            if v != sepbg:
                out[i][j] = v
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Separator rows/columns are uniformly the frame color except for marks.
    row_marks = [r for r in range(h) if any(
        grid[r][c] != grid[r][0] for c in range(w)
    )]
    col_marks = [c for c in range(w) if any(
        grid[r][c] != grid[0][c] for r in range(h)
    )]

    def step(lines):
        ds = [b - a for a, b in zip(lines, lines[1:])]
        return max(set(ds), key=ds.count)

    rs, cs = step(row_marks), step(col_marks)
    rp = max(range(rs), key=lambda p: sum(x % rs == p for x in row_marks))
    cp = max(range(cs), key=lambda p: sum(x % cs == p for x in col_marks))
    rows = list(range(rp, h, rs))
    cols = list(range(cp, w, cs))

    nr, nc = len(rows) - 1, len(cols) - 1
    # The repeated interior color is the output default; the repeated frame
    # color is ignored, while unusual intersection marks are retained.
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row:
            counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    fill = max(counts, key=counts.get)

    lattice = [grid[r][c] for r in rows[:-1] for c in cols[:-1]]
    frame = max(set(lattice), key=lattice.count)
    return [
        [grid[r][c] if grid[r][c] != frame else fill for c in cols[:-1]]
        for r in rows[:-1]
    ]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Find separator rows and columns by the periodic frame pattern.
    def find_period(axis):
        n = h if axis == 0 else w
        other = w if axis == 0 else h
        lines = []
        for i in range(n):
            vals = [grid[i][j] if axis == 0 else grid[j][i] for j in range(other)]
            if len(set(vals)) > 1:
                lines.append(i)
        gaps = [b - a for a, b in zip(lines, lines[1:])]
        step = max(set(gaps), key=gaps.count)
        phase = max(range(step), key=lambda p: sum(x % step == p for x in lines))
        return list(range(phase, n, step))

    rows = find_period(0)
    cols = find_period(1)
    nr, nc = len(rows) - 1, len(cols) - 1

    # Most common interior color fills ordinary cells; most common separator
    # color is the lattice's neutral mark.
    freq = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row:
            freq[v] = freq.get(v, 0) + 1
    fill = max(freq, key=freq.get)

    lattice = [grid[r][c] for r in rows[:-1] for c in cols[:-1]]
    sep = max(set(lattice), key=lattice.count)

    return [
        [fill if grid[r][c] == sep else grid[r][c] for c in cols[:-1]]
        for r in rows[:-1]
    ]
